workflow.name: monthly-sales-analysis
workflow.rules: Never fabricate numbers or sources absent from the real data. Mark anything unknown explicitly as unknown.

step.task: Fetch the schema definitions for the sales, customers, and regions tables and save them under output/schema/ as one JSON file per table. Return only the relative path of the output directory as your final response.

Using the schemas in {schema_dir}, write SQL that aggregates monthly sales for the past {months} months by region and customer segment, into sql/generated/monthly_sales.sql. Return only the relative path of the SQL file as your final response.
Execute {sql_path} and save the results to output/monthly_sales.csv. Return only the relative path of the CSV as your final response.
Detect statistically significant anomalies in the monthly sales in {data_csv} and save the results (month, sales amount, deviation) to output/anomalies.csv. Return the detection count.

For each anomaly in output/anomalies.csv, write root-cause-analysis SQL that breaks it down by region, customer segment, and product category, into sql/generated/root_cause.sql. Return only the relative path of the SQL file as your final response.
Execute {rc_sql} and save the results to output/root_cause.csv. Return only the relative path of the CSV as your final response.

while.ask: Does the report {report_path} FAIL to meet the success criteria (trends, anomalies, root causes, and recommendations described grounded in the data)?

step.task: Read {report_path} and fix whatever falls short of the success criteria (trends, anomalies, root causes, and recommendations described grounded in the data).
